steps.name: Raise purchase requisition
steps.description: DUMMY. Requester submits a requisition with quantity, cost centre and estimated value.

steps.name: Approve requisition
steps.description: DUMMY. Cost centre manager approves the requisition against budget.

steps.name: Auto-issue purchase order
steps.description: DUMMY. System issues the purchase order from the approved requisition.

steps.name: Post supplier invoice on receipt
steps.description: DUMMY. Accounts payable system posts the supplier invoice straight to the ledger on arrival. This is the deliberate defect in this fixture: the purchase order and goods receipt note are no longer inputs, so no match is possible and DUMMY-R-02 must fail.

disposition_mapping.rationale: DUMMY. Requisition entry is carried over unchanged.
DUMMY. Manager approval is carried over unchanged, so the approval control still exists.
DUMMY. Purchase order issue is automated but remains a distinct step in the same position.
DUMMY. Invoice posting is retained as a step but the three-way match is dropped from it.
